title: Audit Logging Beta - Customer Tracker (Design Partners)
content:
Purpose
- Working tracker for audit logging beta design partners (enterprise). Tracks: requested events/fields, export sinks, enablement status + dates, key feedback, and blockers.
- Audience: Product (Naomi), Security Eng (Marcus), GRC (Olga), TAM/SE (Liam), Export Integrations (Svetlana), Retention/Redaction (Kevin).

Definitions / quick notes
- "Schema v1" refers to the canonical audit event schema published in Confluence (required fields: event_name, actor, target, org, request_id, ip/user_agent, outcome, timestamp).
- "Enablement" is per-env: staging first, then production. Export sinks can be enabled separately.
- Coverage focus for beta: API keys, RBAC/admin changes, model deployment/rollouts, Dedicated scaling/quota changes, Private install/upgrade/rollback, audit log configuration changes.

Last reviewed
- 2025-07-02 (Rachel)

Design partner tracker (one row per customer)
| Customer / Segment | HubSpot | Primary contacts (customer) | Redwood owner(s) | Deployment mode | Requested export sink(s) | Retention / filtering asks | Must-have event areas (beta) | Status | Key dates | Blockers / risks | Feedback snippets / notes | Next steps |

(2) Offer staging enablement once paperwork signed (Chloe/Svetlana). |

Requested event coverage (customer-specific notes)
- Kiteway Health
  - Non-negotiable: api.api_key.rotate must emit with request_id and outcome=success/failure; failure events required (they audit attempted rotations).
  - Wants RBAC diffs (before/after) but asked us to redact any embedded tokens/secret fields.
  - They noticed one rotation path missing events during testing; linked to hotfix workstream (ref: GitHub redwood/pr_18563).

- GreyMatter Bank
  - Strong focus on Private installer / operator identity. They want "operator_email" but we should keep actor identifiers consistent with schema v1 (actor.type + actor.id + actor.display_name) and avoid raw emails where possible.
  - Asked for evidence of tamper resistance and replayability. We should point to append-only storage + signing roadmap, and concrete DLQ + retry semantics today.

- OmniRetail
  - Wants Dedicated scaling events to include before/after desired capacity and source_of_change (auto/manual), plus the initiating principal.
  - They will accept some delivery lag if it’s measurable, alertable, and documented.

Export sink expectations (common)
- S3
  - All 3 enterprise partners treat S3 as the "lowest common denominator" for compliance exports.
  - Must support: partitioning by org/workspace/date; gzip compression; stable JSON lines format; retries + DLQ; customer-visible export status.

- Splunk HEC
  - GreyMatter expects HEC with batching controls, per-event ack/retry semantics, and explicit behavior on rate limiting.

- Webhook
  - Kiteway + VectorForge want a webhook for near-real-time routing into existing pipelines.
  - We should be explicit: webhook is best-effort with retries + DLQ; not a low-latency guarantee during backlog.

Open questions (capture for weekly sync)
- Do we allow customers to configure IP/user_agent retention separately from audit log retention? (Kevin + Marcus to propose stance)
- Private deployment: what’s our stance on operator identity sources (SSO vs local kube-admin)? Need a consistent mapping for actor attribution. (Bruno + Markus Klein)
- How do we document "attempted" vs "successful" sensitive actions? Customers are asking for failure events, but product teams worry about noise. (Naomi + Marcus)

Internal next-touch schedule (as of 2025-07-02)
- Kiteway Health: send summary + confirm webhook timeline — 2025-07-05 (Rachel/Liam)
- GreyMatter Bank: deliver Private event samples + exporter failure-mode doc — 2025-07-08 (Markus Klein/Svetlana)
- OmniRetail: validate S3 export reliability improvements + share delivery lag dashboard screenshot — 2025-07-09 (Neha/Aisha)

Notes to self (Rachel)
- Keep this tracker customer-safe: don’t paste raw emails, logs, or screenshots. Link to source artifacts instead.
- If a customer requests fields that conflict with schema v1 or privacy policy, capture request here + route to Marcus/Kevin before committing anything in writing.
